NFL DFS Running Back Rankings: Week 11 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, November 22 · 10 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 22, 3:06 PM ET

Jahmyr Gibbs is the top-projected running back on the Week 11 DraftKings main slate at 26.7 DraftKings points for $10,000, against Tampa Bay. Emmett Johnson (23.0, $6,000) and James Cook III (20.8, $7,900) are next.

Emmett Johnson returns the most per dollar among running backs projected for at least 9 points: 3.84 projected points per $1,000 at $6,000.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 22, 3:06 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Running backs to know in Week 11

Jahmyr Gibbs, DET vs TB ($10,000)

Jahmyr Gibbs carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 26.7 DraftKings points at $10,000, the highest on the entire main slate. That is 3.6 points clear of Emmett Johnson. The model gives him 21.4 carries and 5.2 targets. The salary works out to 2.67 projected points per $1,000, 6th of 22 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Gibbs averaged 26.6 points with a simulated floor of 14.5 and a ceiling of 43.2, and he holds 12% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Detroit is a 3.5-point favorite at home against Tampa Bay, with an implied team total of 26 in a game totaled at 48.5.

Emmett Johnson, KC vs ARI ($6,000)

Emmett Johnson projects 2nd at the position with 23.0 DraftKings points at $6,000, 2nd on the main slate overall. The model gives him 21.5 carries and 4.6 targets. The salary works out to 3.84 projected points per $1,000, 1st of 22 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Johnson averaged 23.0 points with a simulated floor of 10.8 and a ceiling of 41.3, and he holds 59% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Kansas City is a 15.5-point favorite at home against Arizona, with an implied team total of 28 in a game totaled at 40.5.

James Cook III, BUF vs MIA ($7,900)

James Cook III projects 3rd at the position with 20.8 DraftKings points at $7,900. The model gives him 21.4 carries and 2.5 targets. The salary works out to 2.63 projected points per $1,000, 7th of 22 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Cook averaged 20.8 points with a simulated floor of 8.9 and a ceiling of 38.8, and he holds 17% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Buffalo is a 16.5-point favorite at home against Miami, with an implied team total of 31 in a game totaled at 45.5.

Value: Omarion Hampton, LAC vs NYJ ($5,200)

Omarion Hampton projects for 12.8 DraftKings points at $5,200, which works out to 2.46 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 22 running backs the model projects for 9 or more points. The model gives him 13.7 carries and 1.7 targets. Across 10,000 simulations Hampton averaged 12.8 points with a simulated floor of 3.4 and a ceiling of 28.9, and he holds 7% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. The Chargers are a 3-point favorite at home against the Jets, with an implied team total of 23.25 in a game totaled at 43.5.
